description: [forged] Offline format validator for a Malaysian LHDN Tax Identification Number (TIN). Checks that the value starts with a recognized category prefix (SG, OG, C, E, D, F) followed by 1-11 numeric digits; since LHDN has not published a public checksum algorithm, this performs structural/format validation only, not real registry verification. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

tin.description: TIN value to validate, e.g. SG10234567890
